title: DREAMSTATE V4 independent-episode revision gating
summary: DREAMSTATE family revisions now require strictly more effective independent episode evidence, not merely more raw paired rows. Additional observations inside already-counted market episodes cannot unlock another bounded family trial. The live PARALLAX V4 HAC/FDR, temporal, basin, and cross-revision transportability logic remains unchanged.
